summary: MaintProgramProfileInvoiceRates is an ASP.NET user control for maintaining invoice rates related to program profiles. It provides a user interface and business logic for displaying, inserting, updating, and deleting invoice rate records for specific programs, with integrated contact management and validation.
purpose: To allow authorized users to manage invoice rates tied to program profiles, including adding, editing, and deleting rate entries, and maintaining invoice contacts for each program.

workflows.name: Invoice Rates Management
steps: Page_Load initializes control and loads invoice contact info if it is the first load.
User selects or updates invoice contact via dropdown and saves changes.
GridView displays existing invoice rates; each row provides buttons for add, edit, and delete depending on screen editability.
Add workflow: User clicks add button, FormView switches to insert mode, user enters details, submits, insertion handled.
Edit workflow: User clicks edit, FormView switches to edit mode, fields populated, user edits, submits, update handled.
Delete workflow: User clicks delete, row deleted, session cache updated, redirect performed.
Detail insert/update: Values are extracted from FormView widgets, validated, parsed (dates and decimals), and saved.
On successful insert/update, session is cached and page is redirected.

workflows.name: Invoice Contact Management
steps: FillInvoiceContact loads list of possible invoice contacts for the program.
SetupInvoiceContact finds the current invoice contact, populates dropdown and contact fields (email/phone).
User updates invoice contact, invokes StaffController to update contact for program.

business_rules: ScreenIsEditable controls whether add/edit/delete operations are available.
Add/Edit/Delete buttons appear/disappear depending on row type and editability.
FirstLoad state controls whether invoice contact info is initialized at page load.
Only valid UUID keys are used to retrieve document content.
Dropdowns and checkboxes are programmatically populated and selected based on data.
Currency symbol fields switch visibility based on user's alternate language field preferences.
validations: Insert/Update operations check Page.IsValid; if not valid, operation is cancelled.
Rate is parsed with Decimal.TryParse using current culture and currency format.
Invoice Contact ID is parsed with Int32.TryParse.
conditions: If UserSession is null, datasource selection is cancelled.
If GridView has no rows and screen is editable, show EmptyData panel.
If FormView is not read-only, setup dropdowns and checkboxes, set currency symbol visibility.
system_behavior: Caches user session after insert, update, or delete.
Redirects after data change to update UI state.
JavaScript variables are dynamically registered for async and sync postbacks.
Details are shown in modal popup for add/edit operations.
exceptions: Datasource selection is cancelled if UserSession is null.
Insert/Update is cancelled if Page.IsValid is false.
Visibility of controls and buttons changes based on modes and editability.
